summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed method, and speed rendering for unknown totals. track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for non-Sized iterables with no total. Added a CHANGELOG line and test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the two ValueError assertions in test_track and test_progress_track. Not run: tests, mypy, and black, per the instructions not to run repository code.
